newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Volvo 9-mo profit 12.79 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Volvo 9-mo profit 12.79 bln skr.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo is expected to post a pre-tax profit of 12.79 billion crowns including capital gains for the first nine months of 1996, a Reuters poll of nine analysts showed.
Volvo posted a profit of 10.77 billion in the same 1995 period.
The analysts on average counted on capital gains ranging from 8.25 billion crowns to 8.30 billion crowns, mainly due to the sale of a stake in drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn.
For the whole year capital gains were seen between 8.25 billion and 8.50 billion, the poll showed.
The average of 10 analysts' forecasts put consensus market expectations for 1996 at 15.31 billion crowns. Volvo's full year profit in 1995 was 13.05 billion crowns.
For full-year 1997 analysts said they were expecting a profit of 8.99 billion crowns on average. Forecasts ranged from 6.03 billion crowns to 11.80 billion.
Volvos is due to publish the result on October 23.
